name: WTT- CZ Scorpion Evo 3
teaser: Stand aside Vector, a new SMG is here for the fire-rate throne.
description_html:
CZ Scorpion Evo 3

The warehouse was dimly lit, the air heavy with the scent of gun oil and sweat. Skier, a seasoned smuggler known for his connections and unorthodox methods, leaned against a stack of crates, his eyes scanning the room with a predatory glint.

Across from him stood a group of private military contractors, their attire rugged and their expressions wary. They had heard rumors of Skier’s dealings, tales of illicit arms and shadowy alliances. But in a world where survival was paramount, morality often took a back seat.

Skier: “*Welcome, gentlemen. I trust you’re here for more than just idle chatter.”*

PMC Leader: “*Cut the small talk, Skier. We’re here for business. You mentioned something about a new shipment?”*

Skier: “*Ah, straight to the point. I like that. Yes, indeed, I’ve recently acquired a rare find. A weapon straight from the heart of Eastern Europe. Introducing the CZ Scorpion Evo 3 SMG.”*

He gestured to a nearby table, where the sleek firearm lay gleaming under the harsh fluorescent lights.

PMC Leader: “*What’s so special about this piece? We’ve seen our fair share of weapons.”*

Skier: This, my friends, is no ordinary firearm. The Scorpion is a thing of beauty and brutality, designed for close-quarters combat with precision, speed and power. Its compact size belies its lethality, making it perfect for urban engagements and tight spaces.

He picked up the weapon, expertly checking the chamber before handing it to the PMC Leader.

Skier: “*Feel the weight, the balance. It’s like an extension of your arm, a tool of destruction waiting to be unleashed.”*

PMC Leader: “*Impressive. But how do we know it’s reliable? We can’t afford any malfunctions in the field.”*

Skier: “*Trust me, my friends. I have personally tested the Scorpion in the most unforgiving conditions. It’s rugged, dependable, and built to withstand the harshest environments. You won’t find a weapon with a sting like it on the market.”*

He leaned in closer, his voice lowering to a conspiratorial whisper.

Skier: “*And let’s not forget the most enticing aspect. This beauty has a rapid fire-rate of 1100 RPM. Fill your pockets with 9x19mm and you’ll shred anyone who stands in front of you. In fact, I’d venture to say it’s a one-of-a-kind opportunity.”*

The contractors exchanged glances, their interest piqued by Skier’s words.

PMC Leader: “*We’ll need some time to discuss amongst ourselves. But rest assured, Skier, you’ve given us plenty to consider.”*

Skier: “*Of course, take your time. But remember, in this line of work, hesitation can be costly. The Scorpion could be the edge you need to turn the tide in your favor.”*

Installation:

Drop the “user” folder into your “SPT” directory.

This mod adds the CZ Scorpion Evo 3 into SPT, along with its own mastery tree. You’ll find the preset and mods start in Skiers shop at LL2. Skier has some extra customizability mods throughout his LL’s as well.

For now, it mainly revolves around CQB- with future plans to add some extended barrels and handguards to be able to build it into more of a carbine like the STM.

This mod has been tested and is compatible with playing with buddies. For Realism players, the gun is compatible but won’t have it’s own ballistics/recoil tweaks; it’ll be parented to be the same as the MP5.

What is Welcome To Tarkov?

Welcome To Tarkov (WTT) is a mod for SPT AKI that has been in development for over a year. What started as a small passion project has grown in size to incorporate 10+ core members as well as contributions from other well-known mod authors and friends of WTT alike.

How does Welcome To Tarkov change the game?

As a mod, WTT overhauls SPT AKI, touching on almost every vanilla game system, as well as adding completely new systems to the game and its core mechanics. Inspired by open-world hardcore survival projects like STALKER: Anomaly and STALKER: GAMMA, WTT takes SPT’s artificial multiplayer MMO difficulty adders and replaces them with a challenging world economy, loot scarcity rebalancing, a lore friendly quest overhaul, and a map-traveling system built from rewritten portions of the Traveler mod allowing seamless travel between maps. Aside from its changes to the game’s core properties, WTT also adds to the world’s variety of traders, NPC’s, characters, items, and quests:

  • Over 500 custom bundles adding new weapons, attachments, wearables, containers, food, medical, and barter items.
  • New bosses with their own custom gear that will be properly incorporated into WTT’s quest lines.
  • New, meaningful traders with their own lore-friendly quests and narrative elements to help the player progress through the story-line of WTT.
  • New playable characters and outfits that will add to the player’s customization abilities.
  • New quest types incorporating brand new map extraction points, putting the player’s knowledge and familiarization of SPT’s maps to the test.

Welcome To Tarkov stands as one of the largest mods created for SPT AKI thus far.
